div.head: II As 1
div.ab: Be ðeofum. Ærest ðet man ne spa[rige] nanne ðeof ðe æt hæbbendre hand gefangen sy, ofer twelf winterne ⁊ ofer eahta penegas.
Ærest þæt mon ne sparige nænne þeof þe æt hæbbendre honda gefongen sy, ofer XII winter ⁊ ofer eahta peningas.
An ærest þæt mon ne sparige nanne þeof þe æt hæbbendre handa gefangen sie, ofer twelf winter and ofer VIII peningas.
De eo, quod non parcatur alicui latroni ad habentem manum. Inprimis est, ut non parcatur alicui latroni ad manum habenti, si capiatur, supra XII annos et VIII denarios.
[Be ðeofum.] [B] Ærest þæt mon ne sparige nænne þeof þe æt hæbbendre honda, gefongan sy, ofer XII winter ⁊ ofer eahta peningas.
First, no thief shall be spared if he is seized in the act, if he is over twelve years old and [if the value of the stolen goods is] more than 8 pence.
Concerning thieves. First, that no thief is to be spared who is caught with the stolen goods, [if he is] over twelve years and [if the value of the goods is] over eightpence.
(Von Dieben. B) Erstens, dass man keinen Dieb schone, der bei handhafter That gefangen wird, [wenn er] über 12 Jahr und [das Gestohlene] über 8 Pfennige [ist].
(Of thieves. B) First, that no thief be spared who is caught in the act, [if he is] over 12 years and [the stolen goods are] over 8 pence.

note.label: ?Alfredian penalty; contrast Ine
note.quote: enforce the (?Alfredian) penalty of 120 shillings on those convicted by due process; Ine had merely forbidden vendetta for thieves killed in flagrante, and his penalty for others seems to have been 60 shillings

note.label: changes age
note.quote: Highly suggestive is the re-appearance in this context of the age of twelve. Ine had made ten the age when one might be accessory to theft.

note.label: like
note.quote: convicted thieves get forty days in prison, like breakers of Alfred’s að 7 wed (1, 5)

note.label: qualified by
note.quote: II As. 6:3 ... shows that the 120 shillings of excerpt 5 applied only if no damage was done
